# TCADCalibration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A methodology that uses Technology Computer-Aided Design (TCAD) simulations to calibrate compact model parameters against physical device behavior. Bridges the gap between material-level physics and circuit-level design, ensuring model fidelity for neuromorphic circuit co-design.
